ud3.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud3.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena yasojapamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni honti, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
ud3.3:1.4: te ca kho āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā senāsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā ahesuṃ.
ud3.3:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud3.3:2.2: “ke panete ānanda, uccāsaddāmahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope’?ti.
ud3.3:2.3: “etāni bhante yasojapamukhāni pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
ud3.3:2.4: te’te āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā senāsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā”ti.
ud3.3:3.1: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū etadavoca:
ud3.3:3.3: ‘evamāvuso’ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū bhagavā etadavoca:
ud3.3:4.1: “kinnu tumhe bhikkhave uccāsaddā mahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope”ti.
ud3.3:4.2: evaṃ vutte āyasmā yasojo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud3.3:4.3: “imāni bhante pañcamattāni bhikkhusatāni sāvatthiṃ anuppattāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
ud3.3:4.4: te’me āgantukā bhikkhū nevāsikehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodamānā senāsanāni paññāpayamānā pattacīvarāni paṭisāmayamānā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā”ti.
ud3.3:4.5: “gacchatha bhikkhave, vo paṇāmemi. na vo mama santike vatthabba”nti.
ud3.3:5.1: “eva, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena vajjī, tena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu.
ud3.3:5.2: vajjīsu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramānā yena vaggumudā nadī, tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā vaggumudāya nadiyā tīre paṇṇakuṭiyo karitvā vassaṃ upagacchiṃsu.
ud3.3:6.1: atha kho āyasmā yasojo vassūpagato bhikkhū āmantesi:
ud3.3:6.2: “bhagavatā mayaṃ āvuso paṇāmitā atthakāmena hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya.
ud3.3:6.3: handa mayaṃ āvuso tathā vihāraṃ kappema, yathā no viharataṃ bhagavā attamano assā”ti.
ud3.3:6.4: ‘evamāvuso’ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato yasojassa paccassosuṃ.
ud3.3:6.5: atha kho te bhikkhū vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharantā tenevantaravassena sabbeva tisso vijjā sacchākaṃsu.
ud3.3:7.1: atha kho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
ud3.3:7.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena vesālī tadavasari
ud3.3:7.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
ud3.3:8.1: atha kho bhagavā vaggumudātīriyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasi karitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud3.3:8.2: “ālokajātā viya me ānanda, esā disā. obhāsajātā viya me ānanda, esā disā.
ud3.3:8.3: yassaṃ disāyaṃ vaggumudātīriyā bhikkhū viharanti. gantuṃ appaṭikūlāsi me manasi kātuṃ.
ud3.3:8.4: pahiṇeyyāsi tvaṃ ānanda vaggumudātīriyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ,
ud3.3:8.5: satthā āyasmante āmanteti. satthā āyasmantānaṃ dassanakāmo”ti.
ud3.3:9.1: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yena aññataro bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca.
ud3.3:9.2: “ehi tvaṃ āvuso. yena vaggumudātīriyā bhikkhū, tenupasaṅkameyyāsi upasaṅkamitvā vaggumudātīriye bhikkhū evaṃ vadehi:
ud3.3:9.3: satthā āyasmante āmanteti. satthā āyasmantānaṃ dassanakāmo”ti.
ud3.3:10.1: “evamāvuso”ti kho so bhikkhu āyasmato ānandassa paṭissutvā –
ud3.3:10.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya. evameva mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ antarahito vaggumudāya nadiyā tīre tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ purato pāturahosi.
ud3.3:10.3: atha kho so bhikkhu vaggumudātīriye bhikkhū etadavoca:
ud3.3:11.1: ‘evamāvuso’ti kho te bhikkhū tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya
ud3.3:11.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya. evameva vaggumudāya nadiyā tīre antarahitā mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ bhagavato sammukhe pāturahesuṃ.
ud3.3:11.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā āneñjena samādhinā nisinno hoti.
ud3.3:11.5: “katamena nu kho bhagavā vihārena etarahi viharatī”ti.
ud3.3:12.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante paṭhame yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud3.3:12.2: “abhikkantā bhante ratti. nikkhanto paṭhamo yāmo. ciranisinnā āgantukā bhikkhū.
ud3.3:13.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante majjhime yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:–
ud3.3:14.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante pacchime yāme uddhate aruṇe nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud3.3:15.1: atha kho bhagavā tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud3.3:15.2: “sace kho tvaṃ ānanda jāneyyāsi, ettakampi te nappaṭibhāseyya.
ud3.3:15.3: ahañca ānanda, imāni ca pañca bhikkhusatāni sabbeva āneñjasamādhinā nisīdimhā”ti.
ud3.3:16.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
